This application coming on for admission this day, the c
 following:

Order 
This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.37/2023 dated 20.2.2023, registered at Police Station Mahila Thana,
District Rewa (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 294, 323, 506, 376 of IPC.
As prayed by learned counsel for the applicant, this first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C filed on behalf of applicant i s dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.
However, applicant shall be at liberty to renew the prayer for bail after receipt of DNA report.
